# Ephemeral Sandbox
> Open-source local workspace isolation for parallel coding agents working on one shared project base.

## Start here

- [Ephemeral Sandbox README](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/ephemeral-sandbox): Product overview, supported host platforms, and quick-start commands.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/ephemeral-sandbox-docs): Architecture, CLI, MCP, and installation documentation.
- [System overview](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/ephemeral-sandbox-docs/blob/main/architecture/00-foundations/01-system-overview.md): Component-level architecture and request path.
- [Ephemeral Sandbox Console](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/ephemeral-sandbox-console): Separate browser console and backend-for-frontend.

## Key facts

- Each coding agent has a private writable workspace over a stable shared project base and history.
- The core provides Docker-based gateway, manager, daemon, runtime, observability, CLI, and MCP components.
- Operators inspect activity and provenance before publishing a complete resolved change set.
- CLI and MCP expose separate management, runtime, and observability tool groups.

## Primary terms

- Parallel coding agents
- Isolated workspaces
- Agent sandbox
- MCP server
- Change provenance
- Docker sandbox
